description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used for displaying log messages. It implements the LogNode interface, formats log data, and appends it to the view for display. The class manages log message presentation, including log level, tags, messages, and exceptions, and supports chaining with other LogNode instances.

classes.description: A custom TextView for outputting log data received through the LogNode interface, including log level, tags, messages, and exceptions, with support for chaining LogNode instances.
